plan.goal: Perform spatial join between South Carolina county boundaries and weather stations to find which stations fall inside each county
plan.notes: Use spatial join (predicate=within) to match each weather station point to its containing county polygon. The output preserves county fields (NAME, GEOID) and station fields (NAME, ID). CRS is EPSG:26917. Output has one record per station-county pair.

plan.goal: Aggregate weather station names per county to produce a summary table
plan.notes: Group the spatial join results by county NAME (or GEOID) and aggregate station names using string concatenation or list collection. Output CSV with columns: county_name, station_names (pipe-separated or comma-separated). This provides the required per-county station name listing.
